rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for people or groups united in a common cause.

example.english: Everyone united and finally won the match.
example.traditional: 大家團結起來，終於贏咗場比賽。
example.jyutping: daai6 gaa1 tyun4 git3 hei2 loi4 zung1 jyu1 jing4 zo2 coeng4 bei2 coi3

rows.note: Use this when people are united in purpose and effort, especially in a casual context.

example.english: The whole team stayed united and got through this difficult period.
example.traditional: 全隊齊心，先至捱得過呢段時間。
example.jyutping: cyun4 deoi6 cai4 sam1 sin1 zi3 ngaai4 dak1 gwo3 ni1 dyun6 si4 gaan3

rows.note: Use this when separate things are physically or structurally joined into one.

example.english: We united the two tables, so there was enough room to eat.
example.traditional: 我哋將兩張枱合埋一齊，就夠位食飯喇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 zoeng1 loeng5 zoeng1 toi2 hap6 maai4 jat1 cai4 zau6 gau3 wai2 sik6 faan6 laa3
